mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.7% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.7%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer confidence and housing market health, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high industrial production growth regimes (INDPRO > 115), manufacturing expansion signals robust corporate capital expenditure and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 115, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past month indicates strong consumer demand for housing, correlating with higher consumer spending and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 205.0, it signals elevated inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 205.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), higher borrowing costs dampen economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
